# agy-cmd **Google Antigravity plugin: auto-route commands · Stop-hook auto-retry · auto multi-agent dispatch · fresh-perspective stuck recovery · anti-bypass plan guard** [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · English · [How to Install](#how-to-install) · [Features](#features) · [CLI Management](#cli-management)
--- ## What is agy-cmd? `agy-cmd` is a workflow plugin for **Google Antigravity Desktop / IDE**. Once installed, it runs automatically in the background during every chat to handle these things: - **Auto-route built-in workflows by task**: matches `/grill-me`, `/plan`, `/run-workflow`, and related workflows based on scope; - **Stop-hook auto-retry guard**: keeps the agent investigating and fixing when tests or build checks fail instead of stopping early; - **Auto-dispatch multi-agent execution on plan approval**: with Pro / Ultra Boost enabled, approving a plan automatically launches `DeepCoder` / `DeepInvestigator` to execute and verify; - **Auto multi-agent dispatch**: automatically selects the right multi-agent mode for the task while keeping simple tasks in the main conversation. - **Fresh-perspective stuck recovery (all tiers)**: when repeated fixes fail, gives one available investigator a read-only diagnosis task. The main agent checks the proposed fix. - **Anti-bypass read-only plan guard**: when read-only Plan Mode blocks writing the plan file, forces an inline plan in chat and blocks `exit_plan_mode` so the agent cannot bypass approval and silently edit code; - **Live right-hand Sidecar control panel**: lets you toggle retry limits, trigger scope, and free-tier protection anytime (shielding free accounts from paid-only command errors by default). ## How to Install For the packaged stable version, download the ZIP from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-cmd/releases/latest), extract it, and run `.\install.ps1` on Windows or `sh ./install.sh` on macOS or Linux. Requires **Google Antigravity Desktop**, **Node.js (>= 20)**, and **Python 3**. Run the one-line installer for your OS, then restart or reload your Antigravity window. **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-cmd/main/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-cmd/main/install.sh | sh ``` **Manual clone install:** ```powershell git clone https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-cmd "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-cmd" python "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-cmd\skills\agy-cmd\scripts\setup_auto_router.py" --install ``` **Standalone rules only** (text routing rules without Stop auto-retry or the Sidecar panel): ```bash npx -y skills add zou172866/Antigravity-agy-cmd -g --all python ~/.agents/skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --install --standalone ``` ## First Two Settings to Check To prevent free accounts from hitting errors on paid-only commands, `agy-cmd` ships with **Free-Tier Protection enabled** and **Auto-Retry set to 3 attempts** by default. After installing, open the right-hand **agy-cmd Auto-Router** Sidecar panel (or click `sidecar://agy-cmd/panel/` in chat) and confirm: 1. **Auto-retry limit**: choose **Off (0)**, **Fixed count (1–50)**, or **Unlimited**. 2. **Account tier**: if you subscribe to **Google AI Pro / Ultra**, switch to **Pro / Ultra** to enable Boost. The panel’s **Use Boost after plan approval** switch is on by default. When you click **Approve** or reply “implement the plan”, `agy-cmd` outputs `[agy-cmd → 计划获批，自动 Boost]` and directly dispatches Antigravity’s hidden `DeepCoder` / `DeepInvestigator` Boost subagents once without requiring manual `/boost` input (falling back to standard tools only if invocation fails), with deduplication across background-task wakeups. Turn off this switch to keep only `/boost` reminders for stuck tasks. ## Features ### 1. Automatic workflow routing by task scope No need to memorize or manually pick built-in Antigravity slash commands for every turn: - **1–2 files, explanations, or local lookups**: responds directly with zero extra prompts or banners. - **Ambiguous requirements**: asks a focused multiple-choice clarification question first. - **3+ files or higher-risk edits**: drafts an implementation plan for your approval before touching project files (even in read-only plan mode, it writes the plan inline and waits for confirmation); when Pro / Ultra Boost is enabled, approving the plan displays `[agy-cmd → 计划获批，自动 Boost]` and dispatches `DeepCoder` / `DeepInvestigator` strictly once while preserving `Stop` auto-retry state across background-task wakeups. - **A self-contained side task**, such as tracing a call chain or inspecting a UI, can go to one subagent. Simple lookups stay in the main session. - **Repeated work** on five or more similar items runs in batches by default. With the panel set to a paid tier and the command available in the App, the plugin can choose `/run-workflow` to apply the same check to each item and collect structured results. - **Separate modules that need to agree on an interface** can use `/swarm` in the App. Set the interface, give each writer distinct files and name the integration check. A single recurring failure fits `/boost`. A multi-day migration with separately verifiable milestones fits `/teamwork`. [Routing examples](skills/agy-cmd/references/desktop-commands-matrix.md) - **Dynamic web pages or interactive visuals**: automatically triggers the built-in browser or interactive UI renderer. ### 2. Stop-hook auto-retry guard Prevents the agent from stopping early while tests or build checks are still failing. When you ask the AI to edit code or fix a bug and verification fails, the `Stop` hook automatically nudges it to keep investigating and fixing until checks pass or the configured retry limit is reached. For an approved implementation plan in free mode, the plugin can also request one missing project check after a confirmed source edit. This uses the existing retry budget. Documentation edits, a canceled turn or an outstanding approval do not trigger this reminder. It lets the agent stop immediately when: - You only asked a question (e.g., "why did this error happen?", "check the root cause", or "run tests to see") without asking for code edits; - The AI just submitted a plan and is waiting for your approval; - The AI needs missing information from you; - You manually clicked Stop. You can override the retry count for a single prompt using natural language (e.g., `这次最多重试 5 次`, `这次一直重试`, or `这次不用重试`). ### 3. Free-tier command protection & stuck-loop recovery Prevents free accounts from triggering paid-only errors and stops blind retry loops: - **Plan and quota**. Google offers `/boost` and `/teamwork` on paid plans. The App offers `/swarm` and `/run-workflow` on all plans. The plugin skips automatic use of the latter two in free mode to conserve weekly quota. You can explicitly request either for the current task in a supported App session. In the IDE or when availability is unknown, automatic routing stays in the main session. [Boost and plan comparison](https://antigravity.google/docs/boost/) · [Dynamic Workflows](https://antigravity.google/docs/dynamic-workflows/) - **Optional independent review**. In free mode you can enable a review after plan implementation in the Sidecar. The main agent edits and runs checks, then hands the changed paths, relevant diff and evidence to one `cmd-verifier` with file-reading access. The option defaults to off. If the role is unavailable, the main agent reports that the independent review was skipped. - **Stuck-loop recovery**: after 3 consecutive command failures or 2 identical edit-fail cycles, the plugin instructs the agent to pause blind edits and switch to independent root-cause diagnosis. The [routing research](docs/research/multi-agent-routing-best-practices.md) and [free-tier design proposal](docs/proposals/free-tier-v2.3.md) explain the choices. The hooks and installer have been tested locally. Dispatching the reviewer on a live free account in the App and IDE still needs verification. ### 4. Sidecar control panel & slash-command reference Manage settings or compare built-in Antigravity slash commands anytime: - Toggle retry count, trigger policy, and plan tier in the right-hand **agy-cmd** Sidecar panel — changes take effect immediately. - Click `★ Star` in the panel header to follow updates on GitHub (after 3 successful auto-retry saves, a one-time dismissible reminder appears once). - Adjust settings or inspect commands directly in chat (e.g., ask to set auto-retry to 5, enable Boost, or compare all built-in Antigravity desktop slash commands). ## CLI Management You can also inspect and configure `agy-cmd` from the terminal: ```bash # Inspect plugin, panel, hook, and retry status python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --status # Configure auto-retry limit (off / 1..50 / infinite) python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --auto-retry off python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --auto-retry 5 python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --auto-retry infinite # Switch account tier python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --plan-tier free python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --plan-tier paid --boost on # Enable one independent review after implementing an approved plan in free mode python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --free-plan-review on # Verify plugin bundle integrity python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --sync-check # Disable / remove plugin python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --remove ``` Run the test suite: ```bash npm test python -m unittest discover -s test -p "test_*.py" -v ```

# agy-cmd **Google Antigravity 桌面端插件：按任务自动路由指令 · 测试未过自动续跑 · 自动调用多智能体 · 卡壳时自动换视角排查 · 防止偷偷改代码** 简体中文 · [English](README.md) · [怎么安装](#怎么安装-agy-cmd) · [核心功能](#agy-cmd-有哪些功能) · [命令行管理](#怎么用命令行管理)
--- ## agy-cmd 是什么？ `agy-cmd` 是 **Google Antigravity 桌面版 / IDE** 的辅助插件。 安装以后，它会在你和 AI 对话时自动处理这几件事： - **按不同任务自动路由指令**：根据任务范围自动匹配 `/grill-me`、`/plan`、`/run-workflow` 等内置能力； - **测试未过自动续跑**：在测试或验证还没通过时让 AI 接着排查修复，不提前停工； - **确认计划实施自动调用多智能体**：会员开启 Boost 后，批准方案或回复“按计划执行”即自动调度 `DeepCoder` / `DeepInvestigator` 执行与验收； - **自动调用多智能体**：会根据任务自动调用合适的多智能体模式，简单任务由主会话直接完成。 - **卡壳时自动换视角排查（全套餐可用）**：反复修错未果时，将只读诊断任务交给一个可用的调查角色，由主 Agent 验证修复结果。 - **只读模式防绕过审批**：在只读模式拒绝写方案文件时，强制正文直接输出方案等你确认，严禁自动跳过审批偷偷改代码； - **右侧可视化控制面板**：提供随时点选的控制面板，同时内置免费账号防报错保护，默认屏蔽未开通套餐的付费口令。 ## 怎么安装 agy-cmd？ 要安装打包好的稳定版，请从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-cmd/releases/latest) 下载 ZIP 并解压。在解压目录中，Windows 运行 `.\install.ps1`，macOS 或 Linux 运行 `sh ./install.sh`。 需要电脑已安装 Google Antigravity 桌面版、Node.js（20 及以上版本）和 Python 3。 打开终端，复制对应系统的一行命令运行，完成后重启或刷新 Antigravity 窗口即可使用。 **Windows（PowerShell 一行直装）：** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-cmd/main/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux（一行直装）：** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-cmd/main/install.sh | sh ``` 也可以手动克隆仓库安装： ```powershell git clone https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-cmd "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-cmd" python "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-cmd\skills\agy-cmd\scripts\setup_auto_router.py" --install ``` 如果只安装基础文字规则（不含自动重试和右侧面板），可以运行： ```bash npx -y skills add zou172866/Antigravity-agy-cmd -g --all python ~/.agents/skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --install --standalone ``` ## 装好后先看哪两项设置？ 为了防止免费账号误输付费口令报错，插件刚装好时默认开启「免费版保护」和「最多自动重试 3 次」。 安装完成后，请打开软件右侧边栏的「agy-cmd 自动路由」面板（也可以在聊天框点击 `sidecar://agy-cmd/panel/` 打开），确认两项设置： 1. **自动重试次数**：选择「不用重试（0 次）」「指定次数（1～50 次）」或「一直重试」。 2. **账号档位**：如果你开通了 Google AI Pro / Ultra 会员，可以切换到「Pro / Ultra 会员」，开启 Boost 自动接入。「计划获批后自动使用 Boost」默认开启。点击「批准」或在方案后回复“按计划执行”，插件会提示 `[agy-cmd → 计划获批，自动 Boost]` 并直接调度隐藏的 `DeepCoder` / `DeepInvestigator` 子智能体执行与验证，无需手动输入 `/boost`（仅在调用报错时才回退为普通工具执行），且后台任务唤醒不会重复触发。你可以单独关闭这个开关，保留卡壳时的 Boost 提醒。 ## agy-cmd 有哪些功能？ ### 1. 按任务大小自动分步骤 这项功能用于省去手动挑选内置命令的步骤。 - 改动 1～2 个文件、解释代码或查找内容时，AI 直接给出结果，不额外弹窗打扰。 - 需求没说清时，AI 先出一个选择题向你确认方向。 - 需要改动 3 个及以上文件时，AI 先把修改方案列出来，等你确认后再动手改代码。即使当前处于只读模式无法新建方案文件，AI 也会直接在对话框里写出方案等你点头；在会员 Boost 模式下，方案获批后会自动提示 `[agy-cmd → 计划获批，自动 Boost]` 并单次触发 `DeepCoder` / `DeepInvestigator` 执行，同时在后台任务唤醒时保留 `Stop` 自动续跑状态。 - 查一条复杂调用链、验一个页面，可以各自作为单点旁支交给一个子智能体。简单查找直接在主会话完成。 - 给 5 个及以上同类对象做相同检查时，默认顺序分批。面板已选付费档且当前 App 提供该命令时，插件可选用 `/run-workflow` 逐项检查、汇总结构化结果。 - 多个模块要协商接口、相互审查时，App 可用 `/swarm`。先定接口、各写手负责的文件和整体验证命令。单个反复失败的难题适合 `/boost`，跨天且能分里程碑验收的工程适合 `/teamwork`。[选型与可复制示例](skills/agy-cmd/references/desktop-commands-matrix.md) - 需要操作网页或展示可点击的图表时，AI 会自动打开内置浏览器或生成交互画面。 ### 2. 测试没过自动接着修 这项功能用于防止 AI 在报错还没修好时提前停工。 当你让 AI 改代码或修错，但测试、运行验证还没通过时，插件会自动让 AI 继续排查修改，直到验证通过或达到设定的重试上限。 免费模式下，执行已批准的实施计划时，如果主 Agent 确实写了源码，且漏跑了可识别的项目检查，插件可在现有重试额度内提醒补跑一次。纯文档修改、用户取消和等待批准均不会触发这次提醒。 在下面几种情况下，插件会自动放行并立即停下： - 你只是提问（例如“为什么报错了”“帮我查查原因”“跑一下测试看看”），没有要求改代码； - AI 刚把修改方案发给你，正在等你确认； - AI 缺少必要信息，需要停下来问你； - 你手动点击了停止按钮。 如果某一次提问想临时换用别的重试次数，直接在话里加上 `这次最多重试 5 次`、`这次一直重试` 或 `这次不用重试`，就只对当次提问生效。 ### 3. 免费账号防报错与卡壳换思路 这项功能用于避免免费账号误触付费功能报错，并防止 AI 在同一个错上反复打转。 - **套餐与配额**。Google 将 `/boost`、`/teamwork` 列为付费功能。App 的 `/swarm`、`/run-workflow` 对所有套餐开放。插件在免费模式下默认顺序执行以节省周配额，用户可以在支持的 App 会话里明确要求本次使用后两项。在 IDE 或宿主能力未知时，自动路由留在主会话。[官方套餐对照](https://antigravity.google/docs/boost/) · [工作流说明](https://antigravity.google/docs/dynamic-workflows/) - **可选独立复核**。免费用户可在侧栏打开计划实施后的独立复核，默认关闭。主 Agent 负责改代码、跑验证，再把本次改动路径、关键 diff 和验证证据交给一位仅可读文件的 `cmd-verifier`。宿主未提供该角色时，主 Agent 会说明独立复核未完成。 - **卡壳换思路**：当命令连续失败 3 次，或者连改两次还是报同一个错时，插件会让 AI 先停下反复试错，重新检查报错原因后再给出办法。 Hook 和安装流程已通过本地测试，真实免费账号在 App 和 IDE 中调度复核角色仍待验证。[多智能体路由调研](docs/research/multi-agent-routing-best-practices.md) · [免费档设计提案](docs/proposals/free-tier-v2.3.md) ### 4. 右侧面板与口令查询 这项功能用于随时查看和修改插件设置，或查询软件自带口令的用法。 - 在软件右侧「agy-cmd 自动路由」面板中点击按钮即可修改重试次数、触发方式和会员档位，点完立即生效。 - 在面板右上角可以点击 `★ Star` 前往 GitHub 仓库关注版本更新；累计帮你自动接着修满 3 次后也会提示一次，点击或关闭后不再重复弹出。 - 在聊天框直接输入“把自动重试改成 5 次”“开启 Boost 接入”或“列出 Antigravity 所有内置斜杠指令的区别”，AI 也会直接帮你改好或列出对比说明。 ## 怎么用命令行管理？ 除了点选右侧面板和在聊天框直接说以外，也可以在终端运行脚本管理设置： ```bash # 查看插件状态与当前设置 python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --status # 修改自动重试次数（可选 off / 1..50 / infinite） python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --auto-retry off python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --auto-retry 5 python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --auto-retry infinite # 切换免费版或会员版 python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --plan-tier free python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --plan-tier paid --boost on # 免费档在实施已批准的计划后进行一次独立复核 python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --free-plan-review on # 检查插件文件是否完整 python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --sync-check # 停用插件 python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --remove ``` 运行自带测试： ```bash npm test python -m unittest discover -s test -p "test_*.py" -v ```

With the panel set to a paid tier and the command available in the App, the plugin can choose `/run-workflow` to apply the same check to each item and collect structured results. - **Separate modules that need to agree on an interface** can use `/swarm` in the App. Set the interface, give each writer distinct files and name the integration check. A single recurring failure fits `/boost`. A multi-day migration with separately verifiable milestones fits `/teamwork`. [Routing examples](skills/agy-cmd/references/desktop-commands-matrix.md) - **Dynamic web pages or interactive visuals**: automatically triggers the built-in browser or interactive UI renderer. ### 2. Stop-hook auto-retry guard Prevents the agent from stopping early while tests or build checks are still failing. When you ask the AI to edit code or fix a bug and verification fails, the `Stop` hook automatically nudges it to keep investigating and fixing until checks pass or the configured retry limit is reached. For an approved implementation plan in free mode, the plugin can also request one missing project check after a confirmed source edit. This uses the existing retry budget. Documentation edits, a canceled turn or an outstanding approval do not trigger this reminder. It lets the agent stop immediately when: - You only asked a question (e.g., "why did this error happen?", "check the root cause", or "run tests to see") without asking for code edits; - The AI just submitted a plan and is waiting for your approval; - The AI needs missing information from you; - You manually clicked Stop. You can override the retry count for a single prompt using natural language (e.g., `这次最多重试 5 次`, `这次一直重试`, or `这次不用重试`). ### 3. Free-tier command protection & stuck-loop recovery Prevents free accounts from triggering paid-only errors and stops blind retry loops: - **Plan and quota**. Google offers `/boost` and `/teamwork` on paid plans. The App offers `/swarm` and `/run-workflow` on all plans. The plugin skips automatic use of the latter two in free mode to conserve weekly quota. You can explicitly request either for the current task in a supported App session. In the IDE or when availability is unknown, automatic routing stays in the main session. [Boost and plan comparison](https://antigravity.google/docs/boost/) · [Dynamic Workflows](https://antigravity.google/docs/dynamic-workflows/) - **Optional independent review**. In free mode you can enable a review after plan implementation in the Sidecar. The main agent edits and runs checks, then hands the changed paths, relevant diff and evidence to one `cmd-verifier` with file-reading access. The option defaults to off. If the role is unavailable, the main agent reports that the independent review was skipped. - **Stuck-loop recovery**: after 3 consecutive command failures or 2 identical edit-fail cycles, the plugin instructs the agent to pause blind edits and switch to independent root-cause diagnosis. The [routing research](docs/research/multi-agent-routing-best-practices.md) and [free-tier design proposal](docs/proposals/free-tier-v2.3.md) explain the choices. The hooks and installer have been tested locally. Dispatching the reviewer on a live free account in the App and IDE still needs verification. ### 4. Sidecar control panel & slash-command reference Manage settings or compare built-in Antigravity slash commands anytime: - Toggle retry count, trigger policy, and plan tier in the right-hand **agy-cmd** Sidecar panel — changes take effect immediately. - Click `★ Star` in the panel header to follow updates on GitHub (after 3 successful auto-retry saves, a one-time dismissible reminder appears once). - Adjust settings or inspect commands directly in chat (e.g., ask to set auto-retry to 5, enable Boost, or compare all built-in Antigravity desktop slash commands). ## CLI Management You can also inspect and configure `agy-cmd` from the terminal: ```bash # Inspect plugin, panel, hook, and retry status python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --status # Configure auto-retry limit (off / 1..50 / infinite) python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --auto-retry off python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --auto-retry 5 python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --auto-retry infinite # Switch account tier python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --plan-tier free python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --plan-tier paid --boost on # Enable one independent review after implementing an approved plan in free mode python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --free-plan-review on # Verify plugin bundle integrity python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --sync-check # Disable / remove plugin python skills/agy-cmd/scripts/setup_auto_router.py --remove ``` Run the test suite: ```bash npm test python -m unittest discover -s test -p "test_*.py" -v ```
